a: Processes see virtual addresses mapped to physical frames.
TLB caches recent address translations for speed.
Pages load on first access rather than all upfront.
LRU, Clock, and related policies choose victims on faults.
Reduce multiprogramming or add memory when thrashing.
mmap maps files or anonymous memory into the address space.
malloc/free manage the process heap; fragmentation matters.
Deep recursion or large stack frames can overflow the stack.
Shared memory lets processes communicate via mapped regions.
